load-guidelines.desc: Load plan design guidelines and schema reference
load-guidelines.choose_when: Session overview has been read and internalized

scout.desc: Gather codebase context relevant to the bug
scout.choose_when: Plan design guidelines have been loaded

hypothesis-form.desc: Form a best-guess hypothesis about the root cause
hypothesis-form.choose_when: Bug description, symptoms, reproduction steps, and acceptance criteria are captured

bug-intake.desc: Capture a precise, reproducible problem statement from the user
bug-intake.choose_when: Context scouts have returned and findings have been synthesized

confirm-mode.desc: Ask user whether the execution loop should pause for confirmation on each hypothesis
confirm-mode.choose_when: One best-guess hypothesis has been formulated and presented

agent-routing.desc: Determine delegation instructions for each debug session prompt file
agent-routing.choose_when: User has confirmed whether the debugging loop should pause for hypothesis approval

finalize.desc: Write the debug execution session plan to disk and present it to the user
finalize.choose_when: Delegation routing decisions have been made for all prompt files
